required_before_any_dynamic_plan: Choose/pin one model stack; do not pool vendor and behavioral chains.
Freeze actual installation, weak-motion, receiver semantics and initial/reset boundary; retain unresolved requirements rather than weaken them.
Import the already requested native baseline and positive-diagnostic evidence packet; it can qualify components but is not a feasible reference.
Compare actual internal CAP/VIN2 startup and decay to behavioral model with source-matched data.

startup: A versioned actual-rail model or imported native trace with VIN, VIN2, CAP-to-VIN, Vout, PGOOD, all rail initial conditions and port currents; bind real capacitor values, DC bias/ESR/leakage, component topology and PMIC macro-model hash.

If considering the datasheet low-input topology, model and qualify <6 V input protection, clamp loss/leakage, regulation target and firmware voltage compatibility. Do not merely set startup energy to zero.
mechanical_release: Retain actual door trajectory and energy-accounted closed-door initial equilibrium.

A passive release/latch hypothesis needs geometry-derived engagement/disengagement/contact and force continuity or impulse/work accounting, and an independent dynamic comparison over the resulting deflection/rotation domain.
Prove how the initial state is prepared/reset within the declared battery-free operation boundary; do not add a free initial displacement or release waveform.
architecture_api: Artifact-bound support for at least one independently feasible architecture in the allowed space; all methods must be able to invoke the same providers.
If only fixed inherited beam and fixed topology remain executable, label the work restricted engineering development and keep architecture-open task admission false.

phase_1_read_only_import.purpose: Review existing native baseline, positive diagnostic and supplier documentation, then decide actual-rail adequacy.

phase_2_candidate_qualification.scope: Only after one exact qualified mechanical patch a and one exact qualified circuit/firmware patch b are independently justified and frozen, keep W fixed; coarse/fine each cell. Do not force both patches to be necessary.
phase_2_candidate_qualification.stop: At the finite cohort, an unsupported/out-of-domain result, or qualification failure; no adaptive grid expansion or threshold change.

required_plan_before_phase_2: exact coarse/fine solver settings and numerical acceptance
per-solve wall/RHS budgets supported by chosen provider
finite_follow_on_proposal.ordinary_reference_rule: Freeze a successful independently developed reference before any task participant; if none passes, keep DEV-FEASIBLE-01 blocked.

external_primary_reference.claim: Distinct rail dynamics and a conditional low-input alternative motivate qualification, not a new feasibility claim.

what_cannot_substitute: bare mission flag without source and replay
physics source tests without qualified reference
